target_claim_scope: The public_claim_status field records released historical scopes through v0.8.1 and three v0.9.0 capability scopes admitted for this release-source candidate. Admission is not public availability, a hosted Release, or installed runtime identity; selected-version availability requires a matching immutable tag and GitHub Release. claim_admission_rule: A capability may be described as admitted for a named release scope only when its record is verified, admitted for that scope, and has an accountable-human approval reference. Admission alone does not prove a local installation, runtime identity, hosted Release, or authorize a future C4 decision.
